source_inspiration.outside_user_need: Large prompt-library demand around image generation prompts and realistic phone-photo/chat scenes signals creators need help specifying believable visual details before generation.
source_inspiration.pathforge_fit_adaptation: The idea was altered into an offline Phone Chat Screenshot Storyboard Studio: creators edit chat participants, message beats, shot notes, realism flags, coherence checks, and a concise image brief they can copy/download. It helps inspect scene coherence without calling Midjourney, hosted image generation, external APIs, or live AI.
source_inspiration.offline_reason: PathForge can serve and verify the result from committed static files with no external APIs, CDN assets, remote fonts, hosted generation, login state, or fragile dependencies.
source_inspiration.no_copy_statement: No third-party prompt text was copied; source sites were used only as demand research.
